claim: This test is a test used in diagnosing the disease "hepatitis D virus infection".
context: diagnosis: Anti-HDV screening with reflex HDV RNA testing — Hepatitis D is sought in people who are HBsAg-positive, because HDV infection requires HBV. Testing starts with an antibody assay (anti-HDV); a positive antibody result is followed by HDV RNA testing to confirm infection, and HDV RNA is then used to monitor replication. In laboratory reflex testing, a positive HBsAg result automatically triggers anti-HDV testing and a positive anti-HDV result automatically triggers HDV RNA testing. Antibody positivity is not the same as viraemia: in reflex-testing studies fewer than half of anti-HDV-positive people tested were HDV RNA positive.
